description: Failure-handler ingress matrix, instance leg UNSET so the library default TranslationFailureHandler.returnKey() applies (DefaultStrings.java:472). Absent.Key is in no catalog, so every lookup of it reaches the handler. A single loaded locale means localeFallbackCandidates yields exactly one candidate, so the fallback policy is never consulted (:731) and the row is about which handler responds and nothing else.
